t976|Before you know what kindness really is\u2028you must lose things,\u2028feel the future dissolve in a moment\u2028like salt in a weakened broth.\u2028What you held in your hand,\u2028what you counted and carefully saved,\u2028all this must go so you know\u2028how desolate the landscape can be\u2028between the regions of kindness.\u2028How you ride and ride\u2028thinking the bus will never stop,\u2028the passengers eating maize and chicken\u2028will stare out the window forever.\u000aBefore you learn the tender gravity of kindness,\u2028you must travel where the Indian in a white poncho\u2028lies dead by the side of the road.\u2028You must see how this could be you,\u2028how he too was someone\u2028who journeyed through the night with plans\u2028and the simple breath that kept him alive.\u000aBefore you know kindness as the deepest thing inside,\u2028you must know sorrow as the other deepest thing.\u2028You must wake up with sorrow.\u2028You must speak to it till your voice\u2028catches the thread of all sorrows\u2028and you see the size of the cloth.\u000aThen it is only kindness that makes sense anymore,\u2028only kindness that ties your shoes\u2028and sends you out into the day to mail letters and\u2028\u00a0 \u00a0 purchase bread,\u2028only kindness that raises its head\u2028from the crowd of the world to say\u2028it is I you have been looking for,\u2028and then goes with you every where\u2028like a shadow or a friend.

t1063|Caption\u000afind your sanctuaries\u2028\u2028we tend to think of a sanctuary as somewhere we have to escape to. somewhere quiet, beautiful, far enough away from everyday life that we can finally exhale.\u2028\u2028but finding sanctuary doesn\u2019t require escape, expense, or excess.\u2028\u2028a sanctuary is a container. a space that gives you something you need in order to come back to yourself.\u2028\u2028and different sanctuaries can give us different things.\u2028\u2028a library can be a sanctuary because it gives you somewhere to feed your mind. you can find writers who make you feel less alone, ideas that open something up in you, or words that bring you new perspective.\u2028\u2028water can be a sanctuary when you need to clear your energy.\u2028\u2028your body can be a sanctuary because it is the one home you always carry with you. a place where you can belong to yourself completely. where you don\u2019t have to perform, prove, or be anything other than who you are.\u2028\u2028your rituals can create sanctuary when they connect you to the sacred.\u2028\u2028you might have more than one sanctuary. I know I do.\u2028\u2028as you keep building your grounding practice this month, find your sanctuaries and practice returning to them. these are the spaces that bring you back - that help you feel more like yourself again.\u2028\u2028#wordsforyourjourney #gentlereminders
